title: Chapter 380: The Lord Of Disaster
content:
Chapter 380: The Lord Of Disaster

Destroy me?

The black-haired monster was stunned for a moment, and then suddenly burst into laughter.

He laughed wildly, and his laughter was extremely penetrating.

If a slightly weaker practitioner is here, he will be infected by his laughter and become a corpse that can only laugh.

But at this moment, Lu Daosheng was unmoved at all. He just looked at the black-haired monster in front of him, and the murderous intent in his eyes became stronger.

"You're afraid you want to make me laugh to death."

The black-haired monster's laughter gradually subsided. He looked at the tiny Lu Daosheng ahead and snorted: "However, this is the only way you can deal with me."

Arrogant!

At this moment, the black-haired monster still did not realize what kind of existence he was facing.

Still, Lu Daosheng spoke.

He looked at the black-haired monster and said calmly, "It seems that you don't have a good memory. You have forgotten the pain of the broken arm last time."

In an instant, the black-haired monster's pupils suddenly contracted, and the surrounding aura suddenly changed, and a rich evil aura erupted.

boom!

There was another loud bang, and the entire abyss began to tremble.

The black-haired monster took a step forward, and the terrifying pressure immediately crushed Lu Daosheng.

"Ant, you're looking for death!"

A giant hand covered with disgusting black hair grabbed Lu Daosheng, as if he was going to crush him.

Seeing this scene, Lu Daosheng just raised his hand slightly.

call out!

An invisible force flew out in an instant.

The black-haired monster noticed it, but sneered, "After all, it's an ant, huh? What!"

"ah!!"

The next moment, a scream rang out.

The black-haired monster's arm burst into pieces. What is surprising is that the monster's flesh and blood are all disgusting black pieces. At this moment, these black pieces are lying on the ground and squirming.

At this time, the arrogance in the black-haired monster's eyes had disappeared, and the place was replaced by a shock, and a hint of fear in the depths of the pupils.

"That's it?"

Lu Daosheng smiled faintly and took a step forward slowly.

The huge deterrent force made the black-haired monster unable to help but take a step back.

In this way, Lu Daosheng walked forward and the black-haired monster retreated. The scene was in a strange balance for a moment.

Bang!

Finally, the black-haired monster had no choice but to retreat.

But at this time, Lu Daosheng was still walking towards him.

He was scared.

"Do you know who I am?"

It's beginning.

It's another classic scene.

Lu Daosheng has seen this scene so many times since he has been here.

But at this moment, he still asked patiently, "Oh? Then tell me, who are you and who are behind you."

Looking at Lu Daosheng's arrogant look at the moment, the black-haired monster was angry and helpless, and obviously had forgotten how rebellious he was at the beginning.

He never expected that he would encounter such a tough guy.

But thinking of his identity, the black-haired monster's eyes regained a little confidence.

"Humans, do you know the Lord of Disaster?!"

The Lord of Disaster?

Lu Daosheng frowned slightly, and his heart began to recall.

Suddenly, he was stunned.

He remembered it.

At that time, his wife Yan Lingyun occasionally obtained a treasure called the Chaos Pearl.

It was precisely because of the Chaos Pearl that Yan Lingyun was able to live out of the third life and met him.

But at that time, there were huge hidden dangers in the Chaos Bead.

That is to be contaminated with disaster.

If Yan Lingyun had not been lucky enough, and Lu Daosheng discovered it in time and solved the disaster energy, Yan Lingyun would have been dead long ago.

Thinking of this, Lu Daosheng looked at the black-haired monster in front of him and murderous intent, "Don't tell me, you are the so-called Lord of Disaster."

The huge crisis was rushing straight to the sky spirit cover from the soles of the black-haired monster.

He couldn't understand why this seemingly ordinary human in front of him had such great energy.

He swallowed and said in a trembling voice: "I, I was created by the Lord of Disaster. As the saying goes, it depends on the owner to beat a dog."

Now facing Lu Daosheng, he has completely let go of his dignity.

He just wants to survive now.

Because Lu Daosheng seems to really dare to kill him.

"Haha, since the so-called Lord of Disaster created a monster like you that harms people, it must be nothing good in itself."

"Don't worry, if you destroy you, your master will see you soon."

Lu Daosheng walked slowly towards the black-haired monster with a sneer.

At the same time, the aura in Lu Daosheng's body began to rise step by step.

"You are arrogant! You dare to provoke the Lord of Disaster, don't you want to live anymore?!"

"Even if God sees me, he will give me some face. How dare you be a human being?

laugh!

Not finished speaking.

The black-haired monster's words came to an abrupt end.

His pupils dilated and his eyes stared at Lu Daosheng dullly.

The next moment, there was a click.

His disgusting head slowly slid down his neck.

The incision is smooth like a mirror.

The rich black blood gushed out of the neck.

This abyss has since been completely transformed into a land of lifelessness.

"Lord of Disaster, haha, I really want to meet you, but that's it."

Lu Daosheng stood there, murmured to himself, and then looked behind him.

That direction is the Chaos Realm.

"It's urgent now, let's go back and see Xiaoxue first."

"Haha, you still remember that you have a daughter."

A cold voice sounded.

Lu Daosheng looked a little embarrassed, "Lingyun, look at what you said. I'm not bad at all to our daughter."

"Do you really have no idea what she wants?"

Yan Lingyun's words immediately made Lu Daosheng stunned.

He looked at the direction of the Chaos Realm, his lips squirmed, but he couldn't speak for a moment.

After a long time, Lu Daosheng sighed lightly and said with some remorse: "I was wrong. From now on, our family will be together forever."

"You said it."

Lu Daosheng nodded slightly and left the abyss.

Before leaving, he looked back and waved his palm.

Suddenly, the entire abyss disappeared instantly and turned into nothing.

.........

"That monster is here!!!"

I don’t know which strong man yelled like this, and for a moment, the people in the Chaos Realm were panicked.

The Shadow Clan's powerful men who were originally on the first front actually all "seriously ill" overnight and chose to go into seclusion to recover.

The other weak tribes are still among the major powerful tribes.

Basically there are three camps.

The strongest one deserves to be the human race, then the three gods, and finally the neutral Holy Spirit and Heavenly Demon race.

Human race, in the Human Emperor Hall.

An Changzai, Wu Shang and Huo Xingzhi stood in the hall with a serious expression.

Then there are some other strong people in the human race.

Lu Xuegao sat in the main seat and quietly looked at everyone below.

Faced with the terrifying dark monster, they were obviously helpless.

And at this moment, a human race strongman entered the hall and whispered to Lu Daosheng: "Report to the Lord of the Palace, the Holy Spirit Clan and the people of the Heavenly Demon Clan are here to see you."
